acceptedAnswer.text: XOVI's Online Value Index: a weekly visibility score for a domain in Google's organic results, built from a fixed set of 500,000 keywords weighted by position, search volume and click rate.

mainEntity.name: How Often Is the OVI Updated?

acceptedAnswer.text: Weekly, per country. Germany, Austria and Switzerland each have their own index, and the keyword base for each has stayed constant since data collection began, which for Germany means 2009.

mainEntity.name: Is a Falling OVI the Same as Falling Traffic?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not since 2025. A domain can hold its rankings and still lose clicks to an AI Overview. Check Search Console before you diagnose.

mainEntity.name: Why Does a Small Site With Good Rankings Have a Low OVI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Because the index weights high-volume head terms far above long-tail ones. Ranking first for fifty local queries earns less OVI than ranking fourth for one national term. That's by design.

mainEntity.name: Can I Compare OVI Across Germany, Austria and Switzerland?

acceptedAnswer.text: Compare trends, not totals. Each country has its own keyword set and its own search volumes, so the absolute numbers were never meant to line up.
